description: This file defines an abstract class 'PrimaryOperationFailed' that represents a connection issue related to primary storage operations in Orleans, specifically handling exceptions and retry delay computation.

classes.name: PrimaryOperationFailed
classes.description: Represents a connection failure when communicating with primary storage, including retry logic.

methods.name: ComputeRetryDelay
methods.description: Calculates the delay before a retry attempt based on previous delay and randomization, with exponential backoff up to a slow poll interval.
